mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET callback_status='REGISTERED',callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND callback_status='DELIVERING' AND callback_owner=#{callbackOwner} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_parent_resume_request (tenant_id,user_id,parent_run_id,parent_session_id,parent_agent_id,trace_id,status,parent_ready,parent_draft,requested_version, processed_version,inbox_cursor,fencing_token,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{tenantId},#{userId},#{parentRunId},#{parentSessionId},#{parentAgentId},#{traceId},'WAITING',0,NULL,0, 0,0,0,0,#{nextAttemptAt},NOW(3),NOW(3) FROM chat_session session JOIN chat_run run ON run.tenant_id=session.tenant_id AND run.user_id=session.user_id AND run.session_id=session.session_id AND run.run_id=#{parentRunId} AND run.deleted=0 WHERE session.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session.user_id=#{userId} AND session.session_id=#{parentSessionId} AND session.agent_id=#{parentAgentId} AND session.deleted=0 AND run.source_id=#{parentAgentId} AND run.status IN ('running','waiting_compaction','waiting_tool') LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO agent_parent_resume_request (tenant_id,user_id,parent_run_id,parent_session_id,parent_agent_id,trace_id,status,parent_ready,parent_draft,requested_version, processed_version,inbox_cursor,fencing_token,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{userId},#{parentRunId},#{parentSessionId},#{parentAgentId},#{traceId},'WAITING',0,NULL,0, 0,0,0,0,#{nextAttemptAt},NOW(3),NOW(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id),parent_session_id=VALUES(parent_session_id), parent_agent_id=VALUES(parent_agent_id),trace_id=VALUES(trace_id),updated_at=NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET parent_ready=1,parent_draft=#{parentDraft},next_attempt_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='WAITING' AND parent_ready=0 AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='PENDING',requested_version=requested_version+1,next_attempt_at=#{now}, recovery_notified_at=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='WAITING' AND parent_ready=1 AND deleted=0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_subagent_task task WHERE task.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task.parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task.deleted=0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_subagent_task task WHERE task.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task.parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task.deleted=0 AND (task.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') OR (task.status<>'CANCELLED' AND task.callback_status NOT IN ('REGISTERED','DEAD'))) )

UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{workerId},lease_expires_at=#{leaseExpiresAt}, fencing_token=fencing_token+1,attempt_count=attempt_count+1,recovery_notified_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND deleted=0 AND parent_ready=1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_subagent_task task WHERE task.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task.parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task.deleted=0 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_subagent_task task WHERE task.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task.parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task.deleted=0 AND (task.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') OR (task.status<>'CANCELLED' AND task.callback_status NOT IN ('REGISTERED','DEAD'))) ) AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(inbox.id,0) AS sequence,task.tenant_id AS tenantId,task.parent_run_id AS parentRunId, task.task_id AS taskId,task.child_agent_id AS childAgentId, task.result_summary AS resultSummary,task.status AS taskStatus,task.callback_status AS callbackStatus FROM agent_subagent_task task LEFT JOIN agent_parent_inbox inbox ON inbox.tenant_id=task.tenant_id AND inbox.parent_run_id=task.parent_run_id AND inbox.task_id=task.task_id AND inbox.deleted=0 WHERE task.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task.parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task.status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND task.deleted=0 ORDER BY task.id ASC

SELECT parent_run_id FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND lease_expires_at >= #{now} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_subagent_task SET status='ACKED',acknowledged_at=#{deliveredAt},callback_status='DELIVERED', callback_delivered_at=#{deliveredAt},callback_owner=NULL,callback_claimed_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND callback_status IN ('REGISTERED','DEAD') AND deleted=0

UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='COMPLETED', processed_version=#{requestedVersion},inbox_cursor=GREATEST(inbox_cursor,#{cursor}), next_attempt_at=#{deliveredAt},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=#{deliveredAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_parent_resume_request SET status='RETRYING',next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt}, last_error=#{lastError},lease_owner=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND parent_run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{workerId} AND fencing_token=#{fencingToken} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM agent_parent_resume_request WHERE deleted=0 AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}) OR (status='WAITING' AND parent_ready=0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM chat_run run WHERE run.tenant_id=agent_parent_resume_request.tenant_id AND run.user_id=agent_parent_resume_request.user_id AND run.run_id=agent_parent_resume_request.parent_run_id AND run.status IN ('completed','failed','cancelled','superseded') AND run.deleted=0 ))) AND (recovery_notified_at IS NULL OR recovery_notified_at < #{staleBefore}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status FROM chat_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND run_id=#{parentRunId} AND status IN ('completed','failed','cancelled','superseded') AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
